answer: Each identity's usable standing is released only after a sequential, non-transferable custody period, and the release rate is super-linear in how many identities an operator runs, so a fleet cannot mature faster than one identity at a time. The cost of one more head is paid in full and is never amortised across the fleet. The pearl is the serial tenure, the ocean the custody window that must elapse, and the onyx the standing released at the end of it; the pearl is personal, the ocean is not skippable, and the onyx cannot be inherited by a sibling.
